segmente.text: Most people think branding is only for the biggest companies.
But actually, branding is for any company,
and it is the fastest way to create your competitive advantage.
Because branding isn't just a logo.
It's how people feel about you before they have even tried your product.
It's what they feel about you when they hear, see, smell, or think about you.
When your brand is clear and consistent, price stops being the only factor.
People will choose you because of who you are, not for what you sell.
And that's when your business stops being a fight for attention and becomes a magnet.
Invest in your branding, because otherwise you will miss the most important opportunity.
